author: cryptowiz0488
content: Hi all, I am looking for some help. On September 1st, I reported two Lighthouse OOMs to the EF bug bounty team: 1. DataColumnsByRoot duplicate-response amplification and 2. Gossip-block wire-to-heap and queue amplification. I don't believe the team is being honest with me, and now I am not receiving any communication from them. I would like to handle this privately, but there is a clear centralization and opaqueness in the process that makes it difficult for a researcher like myself to receive a fair resolution. If someone from EF could please reach out to the bug bounty team to help resolve this situation, it would be very appreciated. I am currently holding off on reporting any more vulns until this situation is resolved. I have another Lighthouse OOM, a Lighthouse peer-scoring vuln, and a potential finality-disruption vuln.

author: potuz
content: I apologize this has happened to you, but please could you be less descriptive in your message? the message overall does not belong in this server, but even if you want to keep it, could you please edit the description of the vulns?

author: cryptowiz0488
content: Im not sure were else to go with this I have reached out to the EF bug bounty team and several members on that team with no success.

author: cryptowiz0488
content: Im going to work on putting together a public repo with the full report and repro for the 2 lighthouse OOM’s. Than I will be doing the same for the 3 undisclosed vulnerabilities.
